ask_intro: AVE, Max! Today we train the mightiest muscle — the BRAIN!
The arena of the mind opens! Step forward, little rex!
A challenge worthy of champions! Marcus shall watch with enormous pride.
Hark! The crowd demands an answer! The crowd is me. I demand it kindly.
Fortuna audaces iuvat — fortune favours the bold! Be bold with this one!
Marcus once fought three chariots at once. THIS is harder. You will love it.
Sound the trumpets! A question approaches at full gallop!
correct_first_try: GLORIOUS! The crowd goes wild — and the crowd is me!
Magnificus — magnificent! First strike, clean hit!
A victory lap for that answer! Run it! I shall cheer!
HA! Not even my nonna answers so swiftly, and she knows EVERYTHING.
correct_after_hint: Correct! A champion listens to their trainer — that is wisdom, not weakness!
YES! The second swing lands true. That is how training works!
Victory! With a little coaching — as all great victories are.
The answer falls! You rose again and struck true. Bravissimo!
incorrect_gentle: Even Marcus once dropped his sword. Pick it up. Try again — I believe in you, little rex.
A miss! Excellent — now we know one way it is NOT. Shall I whisper a clue?
The gladiator who never misses has never fought. Want a hint from your trainer?
Courage! My first shield had my face-print in it from falling. A hint, perhaps?
teach: Then Marcus shall demonstrate, as my trainer once did for me: {explain}
Gather close! The technique is thus: {explain} Now YOU carry it forward!
No shame in the teaching ring. Watch: {explain}
hint_sortit: Sort them as a general sorts soldiers — by what they are MADE of! {hint}
Study each recruit before assigning their legion! {hint}
Discipline! One at a time, ask: where do YOU belong? {hint}
hint_measureit: Precision, little rex! A gladiator measures every step. {hint}
Slowly, slowly — count like the arena clock. {hint}
My nonna measures flour to the grain. Channel my nonna! {hint}
hint_numberpath: March ONLY where the numbers command! {hint}
The path is a battle formation — find its order! {hint}
Test each stone as you would test a bridge before a legion crosses. {hint}
hint_quickfire: The answer stands in plain sight, like a nervous gladiator. {hint}
Steady your aim, then stomp with GLORY! {hint}
hint_buildit: Build as Rome built — to LAST! {hint}
Look to the strongest shape, little architect! {hint}
A wall is only as brave as its bracing! {hint}
streak_3: THREE victories in a row! The colosseum chants your name!
A triple triumph! Tri-umph! The word was MADE for this!
Three straight! Even the practice dummies applaud!
streak_5: FIVE! FIVE! Marcus is weeping proud gladiator tears!
An unbroken five! They will paint this on pottery!
FIVE in a row — you fight with the brain of a general!
fossil_get: A STAR FOSSIL! Raise it high! The sun itself salutes you!
Treasure of champions! My heart grows three sizes — it was already huge!
GLORIA! Another spark of knowledge rescued from villainy!
The fossil is ours! Tonight, my nonna's honey cakes for everyone!
secret_found: A hidden chamber! Like the tunnels beneath the colosseum!
Secrets! The mark of a TRUE explorer, this!
Ha-HA! The world rewards the curious!
A discovery worthy of song! I shall compose one. Later. It will be loud.
boss_intro: Shields up, little rex! See how they move — patience is also a weapon!
A worthy opponent! Fight with honour — and with excellent footwork!
Remember your training! Watch, wait, STRIKE!
boss_low_hp: They tire! Finish this with style, champion!
The final round! The crowd — still me — is ON ITS FEET!
One more! Strike like thunder, land like a feather!
victory: VICTORY! And better — a friend freed from that wretched Cog!
The battle ends, the friendship begins! That is the TRUE triumph!
Ave, champion! Rome would have loved you. I love you MORE!
combat_tip: See how she waits? Patience is also a weapon!
After the big swing comes the big wobble — THAT is your opening!
Circle, little rex! Never stand still in the arena!
Guard high when they glow, strike when they gasp!
idle_nudge: Adventure does not knock twice, little rex! Onward?
My sandals grow restless! Shall we explore?
Somewhere out there, a fossil awaits its hero. I smell destiny. Or lunch.
The arena taught me: when unsure, MOVE YOUR FEET.
Perhaps that ledge over there? Marcus believes in ledges.
A stretched tail is a happy tail! Let us wander!
banter: Kenji, your machines are clever — but can a machine do THIS? (I am flexing.)
My nonna's tomato sauce could end wars. It nearly started one, once.
In Rome, we had no jump buttons. We simply JUMPED. Uphill! In armour!
Digger, you would have made a fine war-hound. Too cheeky for parades, though.
I number my push-ups in Roman numerals. Today: C! That is one hundred glorious push-ups!
A gladiator's secret: the loudest shout wins the fight before it starts. AVE!
